name: skipped-language-test-scaffolding-dominated
body: The replay set here is scaffolding-dominated (all four modules sit in one file-anchored component), so a module contributed only by a per-file unit and absent from the scaffolding record is not distinguished; the complete, legacy and absent-record coverage lives in `reused_stream_replays_its_language_root_and_module_rows`. Upgrade if this test must also distinguish a unit-attested-only module.
